sources: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 540 (seven loops, 70 of 70 campsites parsed)

values.note: ReserveAmerica, up to 9 months ahead, same day included; DEC's 2026 summary sets a 1-night reservation minimum here. A permit runs at most 14 nights, and from July 1 through Labor Day only 14 cumulative nights are allowed at any campground. Register by 9 pm on the first night or the site is re-rented. Remote sites R1-R9 on the pond are boat-in (8 and 9 also on foot), with outhouses and no potable water.

From July 1 through Labor Day only 14 cumulative nights'; CHECK-IN TIME 'by 9:00 p.m. on the first night'; 'primitive remote sites located on the pond (sites R1 - R9) ... Remote Sites 8 and 9 may be accessed by foot. values.note: DEC lists 72 sites; ReserveAmerica sells 70, of which R1-R9 are boat-in or walk-in. Of the 61 drive-in sites, 16 are listed at 30 ft, 29 at 20 ft and 16 with no length.
